title: Batman Dark Victory #1 of 13 DC Comics December 1999 Jeph Loeb Tim Sale
conditionDescription: Prestige-format square-bound book. Covers clean with no creases or tears; light wear on the spine. See photos.
descriptionText:
Batman: Dark Victory #1 of 13 (December 1999), DC Comics. The sequel to The Long Halloween, by Jeph Loeb and Tim Sale - Two-Face's trial, the Hangman killings and the first appearance of Dick Grayson in the Loeb/Sale continuity. 48-page prestige-format square-bound book, Direct Sales edition, $4.95 cover price.

Back cover: Tim Sale art of Jim Gordon at his desk.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
